margin_definition.name: EBIT margin (computed: operating profit less depreciation, over sales)
margin_definition.source: screener.in quarterly results table (from the company's exchange results filings)

promises.metric: jewellery business margin center of gravity
promises.quote: In the Investor Day and prior, we have said that more of 11% being the center of gravity for jewellery business margin, we would be around that plus/minus something can happen.
promises.actual: Q2 FY27 call, p.3: “And if you normalize for that, then TMZ, which is Titan Jewellery business margin, would be 11.7%.”; Q2 FY27 call, p.3: “Normalized margin, once you do adjustment for this, on Titan Jewellery business would be 11.1%.”
promises.why: Reported 11.7% (Q2 FY27 call) against ≥11%; compared in Python.

promises.quote: On a long term, I would say the kind of investments are required, mid-teen is a good number to aim for, 15% to 16% for the business, at least in the 1-year, 2-year time frame.
promises.why: No reported statements on watch business margins.

promises.metric: double-digit healthy growth in value in the jewellery business
promises.quote: I think overall, we are committed to -- I'm just reiterating, we are committed to a double-digit healthy growth in value in the jewellery business. So that's the only way we'll get to our committed FY 30 goals that we've said.
promises.why: No reported data on jewellery business value growth.

promises.quote: we have always said that CaratLane should inch towards double-digit EBIT margin.
promises.why: Actual CaratLane EBIT margin 14.0% (Sep 2026) exceeds 10% target.

promises.quote: gradually their EBIT margin should start inching up from 8% to 9%, and then further from there in next couple of years.
I think we still, Mihir, would like to anchor our margin target at around 11%... As far as FY27 is concerned, change our stance on margins.
